name: Fixed-Ledger versus Moving-Ledger Criterion

objects.A_Z: completed anti-invariant zero-side displacement ledger, positive trace-class
objects.P_n: exhaustive visibility projection, P_n increasing strongly to I

main_implications: A_Z <= B_n for all n and tr(B_n)->0 implies A_Z=0
P_n A_Z P_n <= B_n, P_n -> I, tr(B_n)->0 implies A_Z=0
A_Z <= A_{Z,n}+T_n, A_{Z,n}<=B_n, tr(B_n+T_n)->0 implies A_Z=0
nonclaims: Moving finite ledgers with vanishing budgets do not imply exact confinement without exhaustivity.
Decreasing defect does not imply finite completion.
Trace balance or visible finite-stage squeezing does not prove RH.
